subject: Mathematics
summary: Lesson 3 'The Rounding House' clears the bar. Alignment is exact: B1.3 primary + B1.1 secondary, expectation text byte-identical to input_row, and the expanded_walkthrough cross-references Lessons 2, 4, and 5 ('Yesterday Lesson 2 compared multi-digit numbers... Lesson 4 sharing; Lesson 5 fractions'). Pedagogical depth is L4: the trap is the wrong-place rounding error (child applies 5-or-more rule to ones digit when rounding to nearest 100, writing 178 -> 180) cited to Fuson + Sowder (1992) on benchmark estimation, and recovery_moves explicitly branch by diagnostic (A: wrong direction -> benchmarks; B: stalls on 100s -> find the two hundreds; C: cannot justify -> sentence frame). Instructional balance is L4: puppet is explicitly OPTIONAL with voice/stuffed-animal/picture substitutes ('Activity is unaffected'); 12/25/13 timing is realistic for G3; differentiation includes a no-paper movement-learner Number Street walk. Clarity_voice is L4: Penny anchors minds_on and consolidation, child-friendly definitions for 'round' and 'estimate', all three success_criteria start with 'I can', and the consolidation has a memorable quotable refrain - 'Five or more, round it UP! Less than five, round it DOWN!' chanted 3x at exit. Mathematical authenticity is L4: STRATEGY INVENT step has pairs invent the rounding logic before Penny states the rule, citing Sowder (1992) benchmark estimation by name; Step 5 contrasts strategies (nearest-10 vs nearest-100 for 47 students) so children compare which level matches the question; vocabulary used precisely (estimate, round, nearest, place value). Lesson-worksheet consistency lands at L3 (achieving): Part 1 maps to SC1 (nearest 10), Part 2 to SC2 (nearest 100), Part 3 to real-life rounding raised in action step 3, and image_assets list the number-line scaffolds used in the lesson; the worksheet faithfully practises taught skills but the format is largely a rote repeat of the station work (same kind of number-line scaffolds and similar number ranges) rather than a deliberately VARIED transfer task with explicit justification - so it does not clear L4. With one category at 3 and the rest at 4, the pair passes.
